The explicit finite certificate supplies 4 elementary collapses for the graph stage, 12 tetrahedron-triangle pairs at squared radius 24, 12 additional pairs showing the core collapses to the geometric boundary sphere, and 140 pairs collapsing squared radius 32 onto that included sphere. Exact convex supporting-plane and vertex-link checks verify the sphere; the 4 leftover 2-cells attach trivially to a simply connected core. The included boundary generates integral H2 and proves a surjective inclusion with rank-four free kernel. All 24 S4 transformations and signed Lefschetz characters are verified and decomposed rationally. The result asserts no unsupported infinite extrapolation.
